note: Twig Template Suggester adds the theme/template suggestions core omits via hook_theme_suggestions_HOOK[_alter]() (block-per-region, page/html-per-node-type, user-per-role, field-per-view-mode, form/container/menu/taxonomy templates, etc.), plus a global preprocess that adds a base_path variable. No admin UI, no configure route, no permissions, no config schema, no Drush. Its only knob is twigsuggest.settings:alternate_ds_suggestions (a boolean, normally set in settings.php) gating an optional Display Suite layout-suggestion fix; no config/install ships so the object is absent until set. Installs at weight 100 (in core.extension). Service twigsuggest.helper_functions::getCurrentNode() backs the node-type suggestions. Since the suggestions are automatic and only render inside a themed request (fragile on this shared site), medium/hard cases are grounded in reliably-inspectable live state: the alternate_ds_suggestions config flag and the module's install weight; execution toggles the flag, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the twigsuggest module add, and how would I use it to give the Article content type its own page template?
evals.expected_output: It adds the theme/template suggestions core omits. For pages per node type it adds page__node__<type>, so create page--node--article.html.twig in your theme's templates directory (and rebuild caches).

evals.prompt: Using twigsuggest, what template file would I create to theme all blocks in a specific region, and to theme one block in that region?
evals.expected_output: twigsuggest adds block__<region> and block__<region>__<block_id> (plus block__bundle__<bundle> for content blocks). So block--<region>.html.twig themes all blocks in a region and block--<region>--<block-id>.html.twig themes one.

evals.prompt: twigsuggest exposes an extra variable to every template. What is it and what is it for?
evals.expected_output: Its global twigsuggest_preprocess() adds a base_path variable to every template, so you can build root-relative asset URLs like {{ base_path ~ directory }}/images/icon.svg.

evals.prompt: On this site twigsuggest is configured. Inspect the live twigsuggest settings and state whether the optional Display Suite alternate layout suggestions are enabled.
evals.expected_output: twigsuggest.settings:alternate_ds_suggestions is true, so the Display Suite layout-suggestion rewrite in twigsuggest_theme_suggestions_layout_alter() is active.

evals.prompt: twigsuggest installs itself with a specific module weight so its template suggestions win over other modules'. Inspect the live site and state twigsuggest's module weight.
evals.expected_output: twigsuggest's install weight is 100 (core.extension module.twigsuggest = 100), set by twigsuggest_install() so its hook_theme_suggestions_* run late.

evals.prompt: Enable twigsuggest's optional Display Suite alternate layout suggestions (the alternate_ds_suggestions flag) on this site. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: twigsuggest.settings:alternate_ds_suggestions is set TRUE (e.g. drush cset twigsuggest.settings alternate_ds_suggestions 1, or the settings.php override).

evals.prompt: twigsuggest's alternate Display Suite layout suggestions are currently enabled on this site. Turn them off. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: twigsuggest.settings:alternate_ds_suggestions is set FALSE (or unset), disabling the layout-suggestion rewrite.
